items.title: How Saudi Arabia's spending spree reached the end of the line
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯的支出如何达到终点
items.summary: Autocratic monarchs once left an echo of their glory in the ruins of the megaprojects they commanded at the peak of their unchallenged power. Those monumental physical traces are to be found in the fertile plains, mountainsides and deserts of the Middle East. But one of their most prominent modern counterparts may only have a digital footprint to leave behind for some of his most ambitious concepts.
items.summary_zh: 专制的君主们曾经在他们不受挑战的权力最高峰时指挥的巨型项目的废墟中留下了他们荣耀的回声. 在中东肥沃的平原、山地和沙漠中可以看到这些巨大的物理痕迹。 但是,他们中最出名的现代同行之一可能只有一个数字足迹来留下一些他最雄心勃勃的概念.
